svg.title: Figue — Ficus carica
svg.desc: A short knotted fig twig bears a rough, five-lobed leaf and a dusky violet and olive pear-shaped fig with a minute terminal eye. A lengthwise cut half below reveals the concealed inflorescence: muted rose flesh densely crowded with ochre seed-bearing florets around a narrow, irregular cavity. There is no external blossom.
